summary: Frontend-only mobile responsive regression sweep across 16 routes at 390x844 (iPhone 12), 375x667 (iPhone SE), 360x800 (Galaxy S20), 320x568 (very small), plus tablet 768x1024 and desktop 1440x900. Required scope (390px) PASSES 100%: all 16 routes have documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 with zero non-decorative overflow elements. Interactive spot-checks at 390: Admin 'Manage organisations' grid — long org names (Blackrod Neighbourhood Plan Delivery Group, Horwich & Blackrod Community Events CIC, Blackrod Sports and Community Centre, St Katharine's Church Blackrod, Blackrod Scarecrow Festival Committee) all correctly truncated with ellipsis, row_R=374<=390, Edit buttons visible (edit_R=357), Edit click navigates to /edit-organisation/<slug>. OrgDashboard org-switcher within viewport (x=210,w=164), parent has flex-wrap:true, switching orgs updates h1 correctly (Blackrod Town Council -> Blackrod Neighbourhood Plan Delivery Group). Newsletter form at bottom of / fits (input R=226, button R=341 <= 390). Compose email preview dialog opens at 390 (w=388, iframe 388x591 visible, grid_cls contains sm:grid-cols-[280px_1fr] which collapses to single col at <sm). iPhone SE 375 spot-check: /, /events, /admin, /org-dashboard all pass (sw==cw==375, no overflow). Tablet 768 & desktop 1440 regression: 8/8 pass, layout expands back to multi-column grids as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: Notification dropdown (`absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80` = 320px wide) is positioned OFF-SCREEN to the LEFT at 390px viewport. Because the header row now has flex-wrap and the bell sits near left edge of the wrapped action row (x~16), anchoring the 320px dropdown to `right-0` of the bell button extends it to negative x (approx L=-263, R=57). Global `overflow-x: hidden` on html/body silently clips the dropdown so it doesn't cause horizontal scroll — but users see only a sliver (>OPEN chevrons visible at ~x=0-55) and cannot read/interact with the notification list. Screenshot evidence: bell_open.jpeg. Fix: change dropdown positioning to `left-0 right-auto sm:right-0 sm:left-auto` (viewport-anchor on mobile) or use a responsive width like `w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:w-80` with `left-4 right-4 sm:left-auto sm:right-0` so the dropdown fills viewport on mobile.

At 360x800 (Galaxy S20), body scrollWidth=368 vs clientWidth=360 (8px overflow). The three <select> elements (events-category, events-org-filter, events-tag-filter) and search wrapper are direct grid children of `grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-3` — no `min-w-0` applied. `<select>` intrinsic min-width is driven by its longest <option> text (org list includes 'Blackrod Neighbourhood Plan Delivery Group' ~344px), which exceeds available track width at 360px. Global `overflow-x: hidden` clips the visible overflow but the selects render 8px past viewport. Fix: add `min-w-0` to each grid child (the wrapper div at line 136 and the three <select>s at lines 146/157/170 in Events.jsx). Same pattern that was applied to Admin/OrgDashboard/Newsletter in this iteration was missed for /events.

admin-event-evt-pending-art event card overflows (row width 324 vs viewport 320). Category badge + long event title 'Art Group — Annual Library Exhibition' likely pushing width. Low priority — 320 not in required scope.

The `max-h-[70vh]` (591px on 844 height) is fully consumed by the iframe (h=591), so the sidebar containing Subject/From/To metadata sits BELOW the iframe requiring scroll to see. This is functional (grid collapses to single col as intended) but users likely won't discover the metadata sidebar exists on mobile. Consider putting sidebar ABOVE the iframe on mobile (reverse stacking order via `flex flex-col-reverse sm:grid sm:grid-cols-[280px_1fr]`), or making the iframe scroll independently with a smaller default height.

Fix MEDIUM: Add `min-w-0` to grid children on /events filter grid (search wrapper div + 3 <select>s in Events.jsx lines 136,150,161,174) — same fix pattern as Admin/OrgDashboard/Newsletter.

critical_code_review_comments: Notification dropdown uses `absolute right-0 w-80` — a fixed-width dropdown always risks off-screen positioning when the anchor is near the viewport edge. This is a common regression trigger every time header layout changes. Consider adopting Radix Popover (which auto-flips/shifts) instead of a raw absolute div. Same pattern likely exists in other dropdowns — audit for similar constructs.

Global `overflow-x: hidden` on html+body is a good safety net but MASKS underlying overflow bugs — the notification dropdown and /events filters at 360px would have caused visible horizontal scroll without it. Consider adding a Playwright regression test that measures each element's boundingClientRect against clientWidth (like this iteration does) as part of CI to catch these silent overflows early.

The `min-w-0` pattern was applied to Admin/OrgDashboard/Newsletter but Events.jsx grid was missed. Recommend a codebase-wide grep for `grid.*(sm|md|lg):(grid-)?cols-` where children don't have `min-w-0` — likely other pages have similar latent overflows.

Events.jsx `<select>` elements with long org names inherently cause overflow at small widths regardless of `min-w-0` if their default rendering respects longest option. Consider using a custom Combobox (shadcn) that can truncate the displayed value while keeping full options in a popover — better mobile UX overall.

rca_of_the_issue.notification_bell_dropdown: REPRODUCTION: (1) Set localStorage role=org; (2) nav to /organisation-dashboard at 390x844; (3) click [data-testid=notification-bell]. EXPECTED: dropdown fully visible within viewport. ACTUAL: dropdown positioned with L=-263, R=57 — 82% clipped off left edge by html body overflow-x:hidden. ROOT CAUSE: `absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80` (320px fixed width) anchors dropdown to right edge of bell button. After this iteration added flex-wrap to header action row, bell now sits at left edge of wrapped row (x~16), so `right-0` pulls dropdown 320px to the LEFT into negative x-space. MITIGATION: change className to something like `absolute w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-w-80 left-4 sm:left-auto sm:right-0 sm:w-80 mt-2 ...` OR migrate to Radix Popover with `collisionPadding=16` for auto-shift.
rca_of_the_issue.events_filter_overflow_360: REPRODUCTION: nav to /events at 360x800. EXPECTED: no element overflows viewport. ACTUAL: 4 elements at L=16, W=352, R=368 (8px past viewport). ROOT CAUSE: <select> elements have intrinsic min-width based on longest option text; grid children without `min-w-0` cannot shrink below that. Same class of bug fixed elsewhere in this iteration but Events.jsx was missed. MITIGATION: add `min-w-0` to each select and the search wrapper div in Events.jsx.
